data.description: 【陈 · 天台暮色】傍晚的近卫局大楼天台顶端，晚风吹拂着陈墨绿色的利落双马尾与红色发绳。她凭栏远眺龙门核心城璀璨的万家灯火，神情坚定中带着一丝疲倦——「守护这片灯火的代价虽然沉重，但只要看到市民平安的笑容……一切就都是值得的。」
data.promptProse: Ch'en rests at the rooftop railing overlooking Lungmen, taking a quiet breath as evening wind moves her teal twintails and grey cape. Dark-green and crimson traveller robe, jade belt pendant and Chi Xiao retain the selected appearance. The frontal three-quarter cowboy view follows the rail toward the city skyline. Orange dusk lights her hair and cape edge, while emerging city lights reflect in sword fittings and the darker railing below her resting hands.
data.title: 陈 · 天台暮色
